svg.title: Cleaning team with a Toyota HiAce-style van and equipment
svg.desc: Five cleaners stand in a staggered row behind a Toyota HiAce-style semi-bonnet van, with every face and upper body visible. The van fills the middle of the scene, showing a broad sloping windscreen, short bonnet, high headlights, grille, sliding side door and steel wheels. A mop, bucket, stocked cleaning caddy, spray bottles, folded towels and a canister vacuum fill the foreground. Blue hatching and thin ink strokes on a transparent background.
